WITH eligible AS ( SELECT p.id, p.supplier_id, po.order_no AS purchase_order_no, pr.receipt_no FROM finance_payable p JOIN purchase_receipt pr ON p.source_type = 'PURCHASE_RECEIPT' AND pr.id = p.source_id AND pr.deleted = FALSE JOIN purchase_order po ON po.id = pr.purchase_order_id AND po.deleted = FALSE WHERE p.deleted = FALSE AND p.entry_type = 'NORMAL' AND p.supplier_id = #{query.supplierId}
), supplier_payments AS ( -- Supplier payments have no purchase order or warehouse; they are global supplier cash facts. SELECT pm.* FROM finance_payment pm WHERE pm.deleted = FALSE AND pm.counterparty_type = 'SUPPLIER' AND pm.counterparty_id = #{query.supplierId} ), events AS ( SELECT 'PAYABLE'::varchar AS fact_type, p.id AS fact_id, p.event_at, p.payable_no AS document_no, e.receipt_no AS related_no, p.amount AS payable_delta, 0::numeric AS payment_delta, 0::numeric AS write_off_delta, p.created_at FROM finance_payable p JOIN eligible e ON e.id = p.id UNION ALL SELECT 'RED', p.id, p.event_at, p.payable_no, original.payable_no, -p.amount, 0, 0, p.created_at FROM finance_payable p JOIN eligible e ON e.id = p.original_payable_id JOIN finance_payable original ON original.id = e.id AND original.deleted = FALSE WHERE p.deleted = FALSE AND p.entry_type = 'RED' AND p.source_type = 'MANUAL' AND p.supplier_id = #{query.supplierId} UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN pm.entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN 'PAYMENT' ELSE 'PAYMENT_REVERSE' END, pm.id, pm.paid_at, pm.payment_no, original.payment_no, 0, CASE WHEN pm.entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN pm.amount ELSE -pm.amount END, 0, pm.created_at FROM supplier_payments pm LEFT JOIN finance_payment original ON original.id = pm.reverse_of_id AND original.deleted = FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN wo.entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN 'WRITE_OFF' ELSE 'WRITE_OFF_REVERSE' END, wo.id, wo.written_off_at, wo.write_off_no, p.payable_no, CASE WHEN wo.entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN -wo.amount ELSE wo.amount END, 0, CASE WHEN wo.entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN wo.amount ELSE -wo.amount END, wo.created_at FROM finance_write_off wo JOIN eligible e ON wo.target_type = 'PAYABLE' AND wo.target_id = e.id JOIN finance_payable p ON p.id = e.id AND p.deleted = FALSE JOIN supplier_payments pm ON wo.source_type = 'PAYMENT' AND wo.source_id = pm.id WHERE wo.deleted = FALSE ) SELECT fact_type AS factType, fact_id AS factId, event_at AS eventAt, document_no AS documentNo, related_no AS relatedNo, payable_delta AS payableDelta, payment_delta AS paymentDelta, write_off_delta AS writeOffDelta FROM events WHERE event_at < #{endAt} AND created_at <= #{asOfCreatedAt} ORDER BY event_at, fact_type, fact_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT name FROM supplier WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT fact_type AS factType, fact_id AS factId FROM scm_supplier_statement_source WHERE statement_id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM scm_supplier_statement WHERE id = #{id} AND generated_by_employee_id = #{employeeId}
SELECT * FROM scm_supplier_statement_item WHERE statement_id = #{id} ORDER BY line_no
